places.name: Stray Dog
places.description: All-day cafe by day, pan-Asian cocktail bar by night, in the former Junior space. Beverage menu leans on pandan and ube flavors with beans from Ritual Coffee Roasters.

places.name: Cinderella Bakery & Cafe (Mission)
places.description: Second outpost of the beloved Richmond bakery known for rye bread and Russian honey cake, finally opening after years of delays.

places.name: Saam
places.description: Mysterious new Thai concept from a chef behind a Bangkok restaurant ranked among the world's best.

places.name: Oklava Cafe
places.description: Newest tenant of the Saluhall food hall in mid-Market.

places.name: Jollibee
places.description: Long-awaited Filipino fast-food chain known for fried chicken, burgers, and pies opens its doors.

places.name: Red Bay Coffee
places.description: Bay Area-based roaster celebrates its grand opening at the Ferry Building with live music and complimentary tastings of its specialty micro-roasts.
